verdict.rationale: Fireworks has a public pricing page with self-serve billing (auto reload, monthly spend limits), and its docs describe serverless per-token pricing with discounts tied to those prices (batch at 50% off, cached input at 50% of input). This shows public per-token pricing exists without a sales step, but no evidence shows actual per-model rates or confirms coverage of every hosted model. missing for 10: an evidenced per-model price list with concrete per-token rates, confirmation that every hosted model is listed publicly, independent corroboration.
